title: Announced Democratic Party gathering against Deputy PM Belinda Balluku
location: Scheduled outside the Prime Minister’s Office, Tirana; actual location not verified because occurrence is unconfirmed.
scope: Pre-event announcement of one planned opposition gathering. Execution, crowd, duration and any additional sites are unverified.
organizer: Democratic Party of Albania, as reported in the pre-event Police notice carried by Gazeta Shqiptare.
participants_original: Not stated in the pre-event report; occurrence itself is unverified.
threshold_50_evidence: No participant estimate or evidence that the planned gathering occurred.

start_date.summary: The Dec. 22 article says the gathering was scheduled for that date at 18:00.

location.summary: The Police notice describes a Democratic Party gathering planned outside the Prime Minister’s Office in Tirana.

organizer.summary: The pre-event notice identifies the Democratic Party as organizer.

state_target.summary: Headline calls the planned opposition protest “against Balluku”; the body records only the scheduled location and does not specify a demand. Actual event and exact target remain unverified.

participants_original.summary: The pre-event notice provides no attendance information.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: There is no evidence of execution or turnout.

state_response.summary: Traffic and parking restrictions were announced prospectively; they are not coded as a response to an observed assembly.

notes: This is an announced-event lead only. The local police-notice report was opened and supports the plan, not occurrence. The separate original BIRN page returned an exact-target HTTP 403 and is excluded from factual coding; Reuters page capture was lost after a title/navigation preview, with no article facts reviewed. Search excerpts are not evidence. No actual event or eligibility conclusion is established.
